title: Garter mantling, viewer's left half (the right half mirrors it)

components.name: Root behind the helm
components.desc: All the cloth on this side issues from one place behind the helm and wreath; everything below is one continuous mantle.

components.name: Upper roll (outer face)
components.desc: The top edge of the cloth rolls over, so the red outer face shows as a broad band arching up and out over the white lining, then down the outside as a big C.

components.name: Rising stem, lining on its inner side
components.desc: From the crown of the arch a branch rises; the grey lining shows along its inner edge where the cloth turns (T).

components.name: Top acanthus leaf
components.desc: The branch opens into a leaf whose lobes fan up and out to the left, each tip hooking forward.

components.name: Top scroll
components.desc: A second branch curls right and back on itself into an open hook; the open space it encloses (E) is part of the design.

components.name: Outer leaf
components.desc: Where the big C turns down, lobes fan outward (to the left) from its outer edge: a lobe cluster at the turn.

components.name: Lower roll into a volute
components.desc: The C continues inward and rolls into a scroll; the lining shows inside the curl (T) around an open eye (E).

components.name: Leaf beside the helm (outer face)
components.desc: Directly beside the helm the cloth's outer face spreads as a broad red leaf, its lobed lower edge overlapping the lower lining fan.

components.name: Bottom scroll and lobes
components.desc: Below, the cloth curls into a smaller S-scroll with its own eye (E), throwing lobes out to the left and down.

components.name: Upper lining fan (ermine)
components.desc: Inside the upper roll the lining face of the cloth shows as a fan of feather-like folds radiating out from the helm, with serrated tips.

components.name: Lower lining fan
components.desc: Beneath the leaf by the helm, more lining folds radiate down and outward behind the garter.

components.name: Tall lining fold
components.desc: One lining fold stands up behind the upper roll, its tip divided like a leaf.

key: turn-over: the cloth rolls so the other face shows
open eye enclosed by a scroll
path of a stem or roll, root to tip
notes: Fills: red = outer face, white = ermine lining (spots omitted). Outlines were traced from the painting and fitted with smooth curves; numbering and paths are hand-placed.
